Title: (Q) LSJ : Spiritual Protector VS Eye of Hazimel

Messages.Author: Martin Laganičre
Messages.Body:
Simple question :

Vampire A have a Spiritual Protector
Vampire B have Eye of hazimel

Can vamp B use the Eye properties agaist vamp A in combat ?

Thanks ,

ML

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On Fri, 8 Nov 2002 20:51:18 -0500, "Martin Laganière"
<soshutt...@limpbizkit.com> wrote:

>Vampire A have a Spiritual Protector
>Vampire B have Eye of hazimel

>Can vamp B use the Eye properties agaist vamp A in combat ?

Yes and No.

Pertinent card text:

"Minions blocking or blocked by the vampire with this retainer cannot
use equipment in combat."

If they are in combat, and no block occured, then the vampire with the
Eye can use its special abilities. If they are in combat as a result
of a block, then it cannot use the Eye.

Carpe noctem.
